description_en: Queries the list of real-time media transcoding tasks by calling ListLiveTranscodeJobs
description_zh: 调用ListLiveTranscodeJobs获取实时媒体转码任务列表
kebab_example: aliyun ice list-live-transcode-jobs --type normal --start-mode 0 --status 1 --page-no 1 --page-size 20 --sort-by asc --key-word 24ecbb5c-4f98-4194-9400-f17102e27fc5 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListLiveTranscodeJobs

parameters.help_en:
The template type corresponding to the transcoding task.

normal: standard
narrow-band: narrow bandwidth high definition
audio-only: audio only
origin: original quality
parameters.help_zh:
转码任务对应的模版类型。

normal - 普通
narrow-band - 窄高
audio-only - 纯音频
origin - 原画
parameters.name: type

parameters.help_en:
The start mode.

0: start immediately
1: scheduled start
parameters.help_zh:
启动模式。

0 - 立即启动
1 - 定时启动
parameters.name: start_mode

parameters.help_en:
The task status.

0: not started

1: running

2: stopped
parameters.help_zh:
任务状态。

0：未启动

1：运行中

2：已停止
parameters.name: status

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page. Default value: 10. Maximum value: 100
parameters.help_zh: 分页大小，每页显示条数。默认值为10，最大值为100
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en:
The sort order. Sorts by CreateTime. Default value: desc.

asc: ascending order
desc: descending order
parameters.help_zh:
排序，按CreateTime排序，默认是desc。

asc：正序
desc：倒序
parameters.name: sort_by

parameters.help_en: The search keyword. You can search by task ID or name. Name supports fuzzy match
parameters.help_zh: 搜索关键词。任务ID/名称，名称支持模糊搜索
parameters.name: key_word
